answer: Time-locked staking makes bulk forgery pay rent it cannot recover. A new identity locks 150 units for 20 epochs. Honest epochs release 5%. A reef of idle clones earns nothing while locked. A vault of 1,000 clones ties up 150,000 units. Forgery costs 60% of the stake plus a 10-epoch relock. At a 30% catch rate, 300 clones lose 27,000 units. The pigment test: capital turns once in 20 epochs. Break-even needs fraud success above 83%.
